_comment: Ground-truth for M3 chart detection on the real-PDF corpus. 'chart_pages': per PDF, the 0-based page indices that contain at least one VECTOR line/scatter chart (framed axes + plotted curve/markers). Pages NOT listed contain no vector line/scatter chart (text, equations, tables, schematic/architecture diagrams, attention/raster-image figures, boxplots-only). 'chart_regions': per PDF and page, approximate chart-region bboxes (x0,y0,x1,y1 in PDF points) for region-level (IoU>0.3) checks; one box per visible chart panel. Hand-labelled / verified from rendered overlays.
